remarks: Looking to get away this summer? Explore all that Darien has to offer in this gracious colonial located one mile from town and the highly anticipated Corbin District project featuring new shops and restaurants. Set within a beautiful waterfront community with two area beaches life in this home will be a welcome respite!  Beautiful new gourmet kitchen with breakfast room adjacent to family room, amazing outdoor oasis ... pool, outdoor shower, terrace with ample seating and fireplace overlooking private backyard. With multiple recreation spaces and work from home areas - this property checks all the boxes. One mile to train makes a trip to the city a breeze! Available furnished for the months of June, July and August. (Homeowner is offering use of entire home except one bedroom/bath).
